# Digital Doorway Marketing

> Digital Doorway Marketing designs and builds custom websites for local businesses (restaurants, salons, trades, clinics, gyms, shops, landscapers, and more) for a flat $499, one-time. The price includes the first 2 years of hosting and domain registration. Founded by Marv Reeves, based in Seattle, WA.

## The $499 website

- Price: $499, one-time. Includes the first 2 years of hosting and domain registration.
- Included: custom design (not a template), mobile-first build, copywriting help, Google-ready SEO basics (titles, descriptions, speed, map listing hookup), contact forms and click-to-call, two rounds of changes, launch, and a walkthrough of the finished site. The client owns the site.
- After the first 2 years: hosting is $14.99/month and the domain renews yearly.
- Every client gets more than one design direction to choose from.
- Payment: clients request an invoice on the website; invoices are emailed. Nothing is charged on the site.

## Optional add-ons

- Small Business Bundle: $34.99/month. SSL security, 5 business email accounts, and hosting from year three.
- SSL Website Security: $5.99/month.
- Professional Business Email: 1 account $59/year, 3 accounts $129/year, 5 accounts $199/year.
- Domain name registration: first 2 years included with the build.

## How it works

1. Tell us about your business (a short conversation).
2. We design your site.
3. You say what to change (two rounds).
4. We launch it, with hosting and your domain set up.
